question: Why did engineers decide to ignite the gas after the blowout?
answer: Engineers lit the gas because methane kept rising out of the crater. Fire turned a loose, spreading leak into a burn kept in one place.
move: Fire turned a loose, spreading leak into a burn kept in one place.
